cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Confess First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to confess or incriminate themselves before you reveal anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before I answer about the office kitchen, what happened to the printer?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Paper jam. Now, why is there smoke?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Did you cause the jam? I need that cleared up first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used sticky labels. Can we talk about the smoke now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Were they the labels marked 'not for printers'? Let's finish your statement before starting mine.

mechanism: A assumes the power to set the order and sufficiency of statements, extracting B incriminating details before permitting questions about A.
confusable: Mere probing for knowledge is insufficient: A must demand B own involvement and use approval over questioning to postpone personal disclosure.
comparison: An office equipment inquiry uses physical misuse and urgent smoke; the family alternative distinguishes a forgotten booking from a false assurance.
seedUse: The existing D16-a statement sequence already turns S01 decision authority into the means of extracting prior confession; retain if rereading confirms it.
